title: Dawning Heartlight

outfit_card.silhouette: Grand Grecian-inspired A-line gown silhouette featuring sculptured asymmetrical draping, architectural gathered hip panniers, cascading cathedral train, and majestic feathered angel back-wings.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Gilded laurel circlet tiara with sculpted olive leaves, floating forehead bindi jewel drop, and an asymmetrical white plume feather pinned to the side.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sweetheart metallic gold lamé corset bodice encrusted with leaf filigree embroidery, sheer illusion mesh sleeves with filigree gauntlets, and layered multi-strand pearl choker collar.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered draped crinkled gold silk jacquard skirt over an ivory pleated underskirt, cascading into an opulent scalloped hem train trimmed with micro-pearls.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Expansive dual-tone angelic wings in pearlescent white and brushed gold feathers, accompanied by radiant solar halo motifs and floating light flecks.
